# FairPlay SAP sender

The sender side of the FairPlay SAP handshake (mode 3) that legacy AirPlay
receivers require before they accept a mirror stream: m1, m3 from the
receiver's m2, and the keys that wrap the stream key into the 72-byte ekey.

Taken from
[objevovat/fairplay-sap-core-airplay2-sender-authentication-handshake](https://github.com/objevovat/fairplay-sap-core-airplay2-sender-authentication-handshake)
and trimmed to what AirPlay Monitor builds:

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `ports/c/fairplay_sapcore.{c,h}` | Upstream's C port: the SAP hash, the session descriptor, and the Phase-1 bridge head. Unchanged. |
| `ports/cpp/fairplay_sender.{cpp,hpp}` | A C++ port of the rest of the Go module (`fpbridge`, `fpsapcore`, `fairplayhash`): Phase 1, Phase 2, the m3 record, and the key-wrap KDF. |
| `ports/cpp/fairplay_tables.inc` | The Go module's tables, emitted by the Go code itself. |

The C++ port reproduces the Go module's m3 and ekey byte for byte;
`tests/test_protocol.cpp` checks it against vectors generated by the Go code.
